title: Formal Apology Letter
description: A template to apologize professionally and restore relationships.
intro: Use this letter to offer a sincere, professional apology.
whenToUse: When you need to apologize formally to colleagues, friends, or partners.
template:
Dear [Name],

I want to apologize for [Action]. I understand the impact and will [Remedy].

Sincerely,
[Your Name]
example:
Dear Alex,

I’m sorry for missing our meeting and not giving advance notice. I’ll ensure better communication going forward.

Sincerely,
Riley

faqs.question: How sincere should the apology be?
faqs.answer: Be honest, accept responsibility, and outline steps to make amends.

title: Short Thank-You Note
description: A brief thank-you note for interviews or favors.
intro: A concise, polite thank-you message you can send quickly.
whenToUse: After interviews, informational meetings, or receiving help.
template:
Hi [Name],

Thank you for [Help/Time]. I appreciate it and look forward to staying in touch.

Best,
[Your Name]
example:
Hi Dana,

Thanks for taking the time to review my portfolio — I appreciate your feedback.

Best,
Sam

faqs.question: When to send?
faqs.answer: Within 24–48 hours is best.

title: Simple Reference Letter
description: A straightforward reference template for character or employment references.
intro: Use this template when vouching for someone’s skills or character.
whenToUse: When giving a personal or professional reference.
template:
To Whom It May Concern,

I am pleased to recommend [Name] for [Opportunity]. [They] have demonstrated [Strengths].

Sincerely,
[Your Name]
example:
To Whom It May Concern,

I recommend Priya Patel for volunteer coordinator role. Priya is organized, dependable, and a strong communicator.

Sincerely,
L. Gomez

faqs.question: What to include?
faqs.answer: Specific examples and your relationship to the person.

title: Personal Apology Letter
description: A heartfelt apology template for personal situations.
intro: Use to repair personal relationships with sincerity.
whenToUse: When apologizing to friends or family for mistakes.
template:
Dear [Name],

I’m sorry for [Action]. I understand and will make amends by [Action].

Sincerely,
[Your Name]
example:
Dear Mom,

I’m sorry for missing your birthday dinner. I’ll make it up by taking you out this weekend.

Love,
Ben

title: Thank-You Email After Interview
description: A polite thank-you email template to send after interviews.
intro: Express appreciation and reiterate interest after an interview.
whenToUse: Within 24 hours after an interview or informational meeting.
template:
Subject: Thank you - [Role]

Hi [Interviewer],

Thank you for meeting today. I appreciated learning about [Topic] and remain excited about the opportunity.

Best,
[Name]
example:
Subject: Thank you - Product Manager

Hi Jenna,

Thanks for your time today. I enjoyed the discussion about roadmap priorities and would be excited to contribute.

Best,
Chris

title: Character Reference Letter
description: A short character reference for non-employment situations.
intro: Provide testimony to a person’s character for landlords or community roles.
whenToUse: When asked to vouch for someone’s character or reliability.
template:
To Whom It May Concern,

I know [Name] as [Relationship] and can vouch for their character.

Sincerely,
[Your Name]
example:
To Whom It May Concern,

I have known Ramon for five years as a neighbor and can vouch for his responsibility and kindness.

Sincerely,
Ivy Park

title: SEO Cancellation Letter Template
description: SEO cancellation letter template for ending an SEO retainer, project, or service agreement professionally.
intro: This SEO cancellation letter template helps clients or providers end an SEO engagement in a clear, professional way. It keeps the communication direct while requesting confirmation, a final invoice, and any handoff details needed to close the project cleanly.
whenToUse: Use this template when ending an SEO retainer, pausing monthly optimization work, canceling a search marketing service, or notifying a provider that the agreement will not be renewed.
template:
SEO CANCELLATION LETTER

[Date]

[SEO Provider or Client Name]
[Company Name]
[Address]

Subject: Cancellation of SEO Services

Dear [Name],

Please accept this letter as formal notice that I am canceling the SEO services currently provided for [Website / Company Name].

The cancellation will be effective on [Effective Date], which satisfies the notice period in our agreement. Until that date, I request that any remaining deliverables, reports, or handoff materials be completed or transferred as agreed.

Please also provide a final invoice and confirm the following:
- Outstanding tasks or deliverables
- Access and files that will be returned or transferred
- Any final billing amount
- Confirmation that recurring services will stop on the effective date

I appreciate the work completed to date and request written confirmation of this cancellation for my records.

Sincerely,

[Your Name]
[Your Title or Company]
[Email Address]
[Phone Number]
example:
SEO Cancellation Letter

Date: June 3, 2027

Dear SearchLift Agency,

Please accept this letter as formal notice that we are canceling monthly SEO services for riverstonefurniture.com effective June 30, 2027. Please send a final invoice and confirm that all recurring work will end on that date.

Thank you,
Jordan Lee
tips: Use the effective date rather than vague language.
Reference the website or account being canceled.
Request confirmation in writing for your records.
Ask for final invoices and any needed handoff files.
Keep the tone professional, even if the relationship is ending.
Align the letter with the notice period in the agreement.

faqs.question: What is an SEO cancellation letter?
faqs.answer: It is a formal letter used to end an SEO retainer, project, or ongoing service agreement.

faqs.question: Should I include the effective date?
faqs.answer: Yes. The effective date makes it clear when work should stop and helps avoid billing confusion.

faqs.question: Can a provider use this to end services too?
faqs.answer: Yes. Either party can adapt the template to notify the other side of cancellation or non-renewal.

faqs.question: Should I ask for final access handoff?
faqs.answer: Yes. If the provider has access to analytics, search console, or CMS tools, the handoff should be addressed in writing.

faqs.question: Is this a legal termination notice?
faqs.answer: It is a professional notice letter. If the agreement requires specific legal wording, use the contract terms as the final authority.
